title: Coherent CNOT Uncomputation Echo vs. Syndrome-Conditioned Readout Visibility
claims: Because CNOT_{0->1}^dagger (X_0 otimes I_1) CNOT_{0->1} = X_0 otimes X_1, uncomputing or tracing out the syndrome wire without Z_1 readout yields <X_0>_{uncomputed} = 0.5 * gamma^2 * (cos(theta_0 + theta_1) + cos(theta_0 - theta_1)).

On a zero-sum pair theta_0 + theta_1 = 0, syndrome-conditioned readout (d_1=0) maintains constant visibility +gamma^2 across all theta_0, whereas uncomputed echo suffers a complete blind spot (<X_0> = 0) at theta_0 = +/- pi/2.
favorable_controls: Zero-sum pair sweep across theta_0 in {0, pi/4, pi/2, 3*pi/4} at gamma = 0.9
